name: Fish a Brainrot
desc:
Welcome to Fish a Brainrot! 🐟

💤 Brainrots earn money while you sleep! 🤑
📦 Hatch brainrots ranging from common to secret.
🐟 Brainrots produce blocks that you can sell for money.
🎣 Buy better rods and upgrade your gear!

🔥 Like the game and join the group to get an exclusive Brainrot!
